prompt: Surreal but photorealistic aerial drone photograph at blue hour twilight. On a vast stone plaza, two impossible giant doors stand next to each other. On the left: a giant doorway carved into a miniature snow-capped Hallasan mountain of Jeju island, with the Baengnokdam crater lake on top, green pine forest and basalt rocks, the open stone door glowing warm golden light. On the right: a giant doorway at the base of N Seoul Tower (Namsan Tower) scaled up enormously, the tower glowing pink and purple, the doorway filled with soft pink light and floating heart-shaped lights. Hundreds of tiny ordinary people in jeans and t-shirts walk from the bottom of the frame toward the doors and divide into two lines, half going into the mountain door, half going into the tower door. Wide composition, both doors fully visible, deep blue sky with first stars, strong color contrast of snowy white and green versus pink neon.

Photorealistic high aerial drone shot looking down at a wide plaza at sunset. Two colossal landmarks stand side by side like giant doors. On the left: Hallasan mountain of Jeju shrunk to the size of a skyscraper, snowy summit and crater lake, with a huge wooden mountain gate open at its foot spilling golden light. On the right: N Seoul Tower on Namsan scaled up, its observation deck glowing pink, a huge open doorway at its base spilling pink light, with love locks and hearts covering the fence around it. A huge crowd of hundreds of ordinary modern people in casual clothes walks away from the camera, splitting into two streams, one entering each door. Long shadows, warm gold versus pink, dramatic sky.
